items.title: Data Analytics Platform
items.description: Linear programming tool using mathematical methods to calculate optimum solutions for a given problem. Supports a large number of input variables and uses the Big-M method to compute results, displaying the first matrix and then the final answer. Repository: https://github.com/massdjelf/plBig-M
